Education

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in Guest Operations, Event Services, Protocol, or Hospitality operations within major events, preferably international sports events.

  • Solid financial awareness, including budget management and cost control.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Project Management certification or equivalent experience is an advantage.

O Electrolux Group, uma empresa líder global no segmento de eletrodomésticos, nós buscamos todos os dias transformar a vida para o melhor para os nossos consumidores, nossos colaboradores, e nosso planeta.   • Atuar como principal elo entre os stakeholders de negócios da área de Manufatura e a TI, garantindo alinhamento das iniciativas tecnológicas com os objetivos do negócio.

  • Apoiar o planejamento estratégico para iniciativas da Indústria 4.0, incluindo IoT, automação e soluções de fábrica inteligente.
  • Fornecer orientação e mentoria para membros da equipe e promover compartilhamento de conhecimento entre TI e manufatura.

Como parte da cultura de melhoria contínua, você participará de projetos e atividades de Lean Thinking (EMS / C2W).

Quem você é

  • Experiência em TI e gestão de relacionamento com negócios, preferencialmente em ambiente de manufatura.
  • Sólido conhecimento de processos e sistemas de manufatura (MES, ERP, PLM).
  • Experiência com iniciativas de transformação digital, incluindo tecnologias da Indústria 4.0 (IoT, automação, fábrica inteligente).

  • Experiência desejável na gestão de projetos em múltiplas fases do ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de relatórios e análise (Power BI, SSRS) e proficiência em SQL.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, negociação e gestão de stakeholders.
  • Inglês intermediário.

Você vai atuar na planta do Guabirotuba, em Curitiba. Um dos principais eixos das operações da Electrolux na América Latina, essa planta é a base para mais de 3200 colaboradores, todos focados em transformar a vida para o melhor com o seu trabalho.

Também oferecemos licença maternidade de 6 meses e benefício mínimo de licença paternidade de 4 semanas para novos pais; esta novidade é uma diretriz global e garante a valorização de todos - não importa quem sejam, em que país estejam, ou que função exercem na empresa.

Acreditamos no potencial de todas as pessoas para dar asas a ideias, independentemente de expressão de gênero, raça, religião, orientação afetivo-sexual, origem, idade e deficiência. No mundo da RedBull, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas.

Nossos Student Marketeers fazem parte do programa de embaixadores de marca mais dinâmico e capacitado do mundo. Eles entendem o público-alvo da RedBull e são responsáveis por impulsionar a imagem da marca e a funcionalidade do produto em seus campi e regiões. O objetivo do programa é alcançar novos consumidores, entusiasmar estudantes universitários, aumentar vendas e gerenciar a marca RedBull em seus campi. Isso inclui contato direto com consumidores e clientes, convidando à experimentação de produtos, além de trabalhar em eventos da RedBull para garantir uma experiência de marca inesquecível. Os Student Marketeers valorizam a flexibilidade e adoram trabalhar em ambientes criativos.

Responsabilidades

As principais responsabilidades incluem:

  • Representar a marca de forma excepcional por meio de interações diárias com consumidores e clientes, vivendo os valores da RedBull.
  • Convidar pessoas a experimentarem RedBull nos locais e momentos certos, respondendo às perguntas dos consumidores.
  • Criar e executar planos inovadores no campus, envolvendo estudantes e promovendo a marca na universidade.
  • Estabelecer rede de contatos com responsáveis-chave e construir relacionamentos sólidos.
  • Impulsionar o envolvimento da marca nas redes sociais com conteúdo autêntico.
  • Participar de eventos da RedBull e apoiados, garantindo experiências marcantes.
  • Construir relacionamentos com pontos de venda locais, garantindo visibilidade e disponibilidade do produto.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de vendas para abrir novos pontos de distribuição.
  • Utilizar recursos do mundo RedBull para manter a marca presente nos clientes locais.
  • Assegurar a execução de padrões de excelência e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Planejar e relatar atividades de forma pontual e precisa na plataforma online.
  • Contribuir com informações de tendências e oportunidades locais para as plataformas de mídia da RedBull.

Requisitos

  • Paixão pela marca e produto RedBull.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação.
  • Personalidade carismática, enérgica, positiva e extrovertida.
  • Imersão na vida estudantil e conhecimento do cenário universitário, cidade e região.
  • Sociabilidade e facilidade de relacionamento.
  • Espírito criativo, empreendedor, responsável e proativo.
  • Capacidade de conciliar trabalho de meio período com estudos.
  • Desejo de aprender e desenvolver habilidades em marketing e vendas.
  • Conexões com grupos e influenciadores no campus.

  • Monitor supply chain KPIs linked to SMAT: inventory accuracy, backlog, availability by work package, receiving/shipping efficiency, among others.

About You

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Production, Materials, Industrial, Mechanical or related fields), Business Administration, Logistics, or Supply Chain.
  • Additional certifications or training in Hexagon Smart Materials/ Smart Construction are strong advantages.
  • Advanced expertise in Smart Materials (SMAT/ Hexagon) — configuration, operation, governance, and integration.
  • Solid understanding of the industrial material lifecycle in EPC/EPCM projects.
  • Proficiency in inventory control, MTO, MDR, BOM, and technical classification of materials.
  • Experience with integrated ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Totvs or equivalents).
  • Strong analytical skills for data interpretation, reporting, and decision-making support.

title: Consultor de negócios
description:
Educador | Consultor | Ensino Superior | TI |Terceiro Setor: Captação de Recursos, Governança e Sustentabilidade.

Descrição da vaga

Somos a ECO Consultoria, uma empresa dedicada ao desenvolvimento de soluções tecnológicas para organizações do Terceiro Setor, com o objetivo de promover a sustentabilidade dos negócios sociais e fortalecer as causas institucionais das Organizações da Sociedade Civil (OSCs). Nossa atuação se dá por meio da implementação e acompanhamento de estratégias e tecnologias nas áreas de gestão organizacional e captação de recursos, oferecendo sistemas de informação que atendem a diversas necessidades das organizações em setores como saúde, assistência social, hotelaria, educação, transporte, manutenção, estoque, compras e financeiro.

Além disso, disponibilizamos soluções tecnológicas inovadoras para a captação de recursos financeiros via telemarketing, ampliando as possibilidades de financiamento para as OSCs. Nosso diferencial está na constante inovação e no investimento contínuo em capacitação, o que nos permite oferecer produtos e serviços de alta qualidade, sustentados por uma equipe de profissionais com competências competitivas para atender às demandas do mercado. Nosso compromisso é transformar o impacto das OSCs por meio de tecnologias que otimizam processos e potencializam a sustentabilidade e o alcance das causas que essas organizações defendem.

Perfil do Consultor:

Estamos buscando um Consultor de Negócios que se alinhe aos valores da ECO Consultoria e que possua as seguintes qualificações:

  • Formação Acadêmica: Nível superior completo, preferencialmente nas áreas de Administração, Recursos Humanos, Marketing ou Comercial.
  • Experiência no Terceiro Setor: Conhecimento das dinâmicas de captação de recursos para ONGs, especialmente por meio de telemarketing.
  • Habilidade em Gestão de Equipes: Capacidade de treinar e motivar equipes de telemarketing, com foco em resultados e nas melhores práticas.
  • Foco em Resultados: Histórico de sucesso em campanhas de telemarketing, com habilidades para desenvolver estratégias eficazes de engajamento e captação de recursos.
  • Comunicação e Persuasão: Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e persuasão, capazes de desenvolver scripts eficientes e abordar doadores de forma ética e assertiva.
  • Adaptação às Tecnologias: Capacidade de entender e integrar novas tecnologias e sistemas de gestão.
  • Conhecimento em Telemarketing: Vendas, captação de doadores, agendamento, pesquisas, cobrança, fidelização, suporte.
  • Disponibilidade para Viajar: O consultor deve ter disponibilidade para viagens, atendendo a demandas presenciais, treinamentos e reuniões em diferentes localidades onde a ECO Consultoria atua.

Benefícios:

  • Remuneração: Salário fixo, mais comissionamento baseado em desempenho, garantindo um pacote de remuneração atrativo que recompensa os resultados alcançados.
  • Plano Odontológico: Benefício adicional que visa promover o bem-estar e a saúde dos nossos colaboradores.

Se você é um profissional orientado a resultados, com experiência no Terceiro Setor e interesse em fazer a diferença por meio de soluções tecnológicas inovadoras, a ECO Consultoria é o lugar para você!

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Ariox is an iPaas, or Integration Platform as a Service company. Our iPass solution is Lumino, which efficiently integrates, automates and connects all/any data from various day to day operating systems and applications. For example, an iPaaS can allow a user to connect their ERP, CRM, WMS, or TMS software to each other and share data that may have previously been sorted, moved or shared across systems manually by an employee or other resource. Traditionally, integrating data was a complex process that required equally complex custom solutions and in most cases, was cost prohibitive for the majority of enterprises. iPaaS works to democratize this data sharing and gives control of the integration process to the user themselves. Many implementations of Lumino can be done with lightning speed through the use of pre-built application connectors that make for a plug and play integration experience. Once application connectors are in place, users have the ability to configure those connections, whether that be altering data as it passes between systems, controlling the order of operations within an integration, or simply designating which data sets are part of a given integration.

Ariox is seeking a Full Stack Developer ready to work with new technologies and architecture in this forward-thinking organization that is constantly pushing boundaries. At Ariox, developers must be able to take complete, end-to-end ownership of projects across the entire stack, and be comfortable with both front and back-end programming. Successful candidates will be responsible for developing and designing front-end web architecture, ensuring the responsiveness of applications, coding using pre-established development frameworks and patterns, and utilizing third-party libraries. Ideal candidates will have experience building products across the stack and a firm understanding of web frameworks, APIs, databases, and multiple back-end languages. The successful candidate will be required to complete projects rapidly, and have strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Successful candidates will join a small AGILE team working at the forefront of new technology, solving challenges that impact both the front-end and back-end architecture, and ultimately, delivering unique global user experiences. This role is ideal for someone who is established as a developer and loves to learn new skills. This position will demand continuous improvement of skillsets and technical abilities.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

  • Adhere to and be actively engaged in the established AGILE/ SCRUM process.
  • Responsible for reading and interpreting user stories and creating solution(s) that satisfy the requirements by producing readable and maintainable code using established coding patterns.
  • Provide on-going support for the entire developed product.
  • Create process flowcharts, diagrams, and other related documentation.
  • Engage in the acquisition of current job knowledge by studying new development tools, programming techniques, and computing equipment; participating in educational opportunities; reading professional publications; maintaining personal and professional networks; participating in professional organizations.
  • Participate actively in a hands-on team experience to be productive and make an impact on a daily basis.
  • Collaborate actively and fully with the software development team.

Experience

  • 2 - 3 years of full-stack development experience

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field
  • Understanding of SOLID principles and clean architecture
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code
  • Have strong analytical skills and the ability to think outside the box
  • Be an excellent communicator, a team player, have a positive attitude, and a willingness to get things done
  • Possess an openness and eagerness to learn new technologies
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office suite of tools

Processo Seletivo para seleção de bolsista Gestor(a) Acadêmico no IQSC/USP

Este Processo Seletivo tem por finalidade selecionar um(a) candidato(a) com título de Doutor, para recebimento de uma bolsa para atuar no Programa de Formação em Gestão Acadêmica de Projetos de Pesquisa (FGA), de acordo com as regras estabelecidas pela Resolução CoPI N° 8310, de 29 de agosto de 2022, para atuar no Instituto de Química de São Carlos (IQSC) da Universidade de São Paulo (USP), Campus de São Carlos.

1.1. Atividades a serem desenvolvidas

  • I – Gestão dos entregáveis do projeto, da seleção e supervisão de pessoal, das compras e importações, das entregas de relatórios, da propriedade intelectual, das licenças e autorizações necessárias.
  • II – Prospectar parceiros e financiadores.
  • III – Coordenar iniciativas de divulgação e comunicação.
  • IV – Representar o grupo em conferências e eventos internacionais, bem como em reuniões com potenciais parceiros e financiadores.

1.2. Grupos de pesquisa atendidos

  • Grupo de Processos Eletroquímicos e Ambientais (GPEA), coordenado Prof. Marcos Lanza, localizado no Edifício de Química Ambiental do IQSC, Área II do Campus de São Carlos.
  • Grupo de Cromatografia (CROMA), coordenado Prof. Fernando Lanças, localizado no Edifício de Q9 do IQSC, Área I do Campus de São Carlos.

2. Requisitos do(a) candidato(a)

  • O(A) candidato(a) ao Programa deve possuir título de Doutor de qualquer instituição, nacional ou estrangeira.
  • O(A) candidato(a) deve possuir experiência na área de conhecimento do projeto em que realizará seu treinamento/participará.
  • Docentes, servidores(as) técnicos e administrativos, alunos(as), pós-doutorandos(as) e pesquisadores(as) colaboradores(as) da USP não podem participar do Programa, mesmo em caso de afastamento.
  • O(A) participante não poderá possuir vínculo empregatício, mesmo em caso de afastamento.
  • A dedicação ao Programa será de 40 (quarenta) horas semanais em regime de dedicação exclusiva.
  • Não será permitida a acumulação da bolsa do Programa de Formação em Gestão Acadêmica de Projetos de Pesquisa com bolsas pagas por agências de fomento, empresas e demais financiadores, e outras bolsas da Universidade de São Paulo.

3. Valor da bolsa

3.1. R$ 8.479,20 (oito mil quatrocentos e nove reais e vinte centavos) mensais brutos (antes da incidência de imposto de renda) pelo período de 12 meses.

3.2. As bolsas poderão ser prorrogadas por até 12 meses, a critério da Pró-Reitoria de Pesquisa e Inovação, e de acordo com a disponibilidade de recursos.

4. Prazos previstos para inscrições, documentos e seleção do bolsista

4.1. O(A) candidato(a) interessado na bolsa deverá efetuar sua inscrição enviando toda a documentação exigida para os seguintes e-mails e até as 18h do dia .

4.2. Os documentos requeridos para a inscrição são a comprovação do título de doutor; o curriculum vitae; e os documentos pessoais.

Fonte: Marcos Lanza (IQSC/USP)

title: Senior Programme Officer, Business & Nature
description:
Senior Programme Officer, Business & Nature

Background

The International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) is a global Union of over 1,400 members, primarily government and civil society organizations, supported by more than 18,000 experts. Headquartered in Gland, Switzerland, with offices worldwide, IUCN is recognized as the leading authority on the status of nature and the actions needed to protect it.

As a trusted source of conservation data, analysis, and standards, IUCN provides a neutral platform where governments, NGOs, businesses, Indigenous peoples, and other stakeholders collaborate to advance sustainable development. Its global projects blend scientific innovation with local knowledge to restore ecosystems, halt habitat loss, and enhance human well‑being.

The Business & Nature Global Team drives the adoption of nature‑positive business practices by leveraging IUCN’s tools, metrics, and partnerships across corporate, sectoral, and regulatory levels. This work is delivered through collaborations with IUCN’s regional offices, members, and partners worldwide.

In South America, IUCN’s Regional Office (IUCN SUR) has operated from Quito, Ecuador, since 1992, with a National Office in Brasília, Brazil, since 2010. In Brazil, IUCN implements regional and global initiatives on protected areas, the Green List, Nature‑based Solutions, Forest Landscape Restoration, and other Nature 2030 priorities. Partners include federal and state agencies, academia, NGOs (24 members), and growing private‑sector collaborations. IUCN is also engaged in strategic collaborations with leading private sector actors and intends to expand this portfolio with this position.

This position is based in São Paulo, Brazil. The person will be contracted according to the Brazilian law (CLT), and it will include medical and life insurance.

Job Description

Overall Responsibility

The Senior Programme Officer in Business & Nature is responsible for the technical management, implementation and development of a portfolio of collaborative partnerships with companies and public actors in sectors in Brazil with important impacts on biodiversity (including but not limited to the metals and mining, aggregates, paper & pulp, chemicals industries, nature‑based industries and agrifood) to support the delivery of measurable Nature Positive outcomes aligned with IUCN Programme targets, whilst generating high quality knowledge and learning. In doing so, s/he will be expected to collaborate with the IUCN Business & Nature Global team, IUCN Regional Office for South America (IUCN SUR), the Brazilian Country Office, the Brazilian National Committee of IUCN members, IUCN thematic Teams, as well as with IUCN Commissions as necessary to ensure that recommendations and lessons learnt are integrated into the programmes policy and knowledge work.

Specific Responsibilities and Duties

Under the supervision of the Regional Programme Coordinator and close coordination of the Business and Nature Senior Programme Manager, the main duties and responsibilities include:

1. Portfolio technical implementation and development

  • Develop private sector use and application of IUCN standards, metrics, and tools, such as the IUCN RHINO approach (Rapid High‑Integrity Nature‑positive Outcomes), Species Threat Abatement and Restoration (STAR) metric, NbS Standard, and the Integrated Biodiversity Assessment Tool (IBAT) while promoting the application of the mitigation hierarchy and IUCN’s relevant policies in Brazil;
  • Collaborate with companies and sectoral bodies in Brazil to refine IUCN tools, providing technical feedback to IUCN global teams to strengthen knowledge and best practices on nature‑positive approaches, and increase their relevance and uptake in the business sector;
  • Explore ways to combine IUCN tools (e.g., STAR) with other approaches, such as Life Cycle Assessments, to enhance their relevance and use across sectors;
  • Facilitate Independent Scientific and Technical Advisory Panels in Brazil, providing strategic expertise to address complex and controversial issues and build trust amongst stakeholders;
  • Help identify opportunities and support the development of technical proposals to the private sector in Brazil, that use IUCN’s data, tools, and expertise to deliver Nature Positive results;
  • Develop concepts and funding proposals to donors for projects that strengthen enabling conditions—such as policies and regulations—supporting the sectoral transition toward Nature Positive outcomes;
  • Support the regional team in establishing and strengthening collaborations with the private sector in the region and in preparing high‑quality technical proposals.

2. Project portfolio management, delivery, and quality assurance

  • Provide technical assistance and capacity building to private sector partners, contributing to sectoral transformation and high‑quality project outcomes;
  • Ensure timely and effective delivery of projects and initiatives in line with annual workplans and IUCN standards;
  • Manage project resources—including financial, human, and intellectual—efficiently and adaptively, in accordance with IUCN project management guidelines;
  • Engage and oversee consultants and external project counterparts to maintain technical quality and support project delivery;
  • Lead coordination with internal teams, external partners, and IUCN units—including HQ, Regional, and Country Offices—to ensure smooth, joint implementation and delivery of projects;
  • Work with regional (and national) colleagues to ensure effective implementation of Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning frameworks for the business lines and project portfolio.
  • Manage project planning, budgeting, reporting, and documentation following IUCN’s tools and policies (e.g., Smartsheet, project portal, risk management);
  • Support the organization of workshops, meetings, and other events that strengthen project implementation and stakeholder engagement.

3. Capacity building, Knowledge generation and Communication

  • Ensure key results and lessons learnt are communicated in insightful knowledge products and promoted through various media channels and networks, to reach both external and internal audiences. Coordinate with national, regional and global communication focal points for this purpose.
  • Strengthen IUCN's capacity, influence and external visibility on work with the private sector, including by developing new training programmes to promote IUCN’s tools and approaches for the private sector and support their uptake (in collaboration with the IUCN Academy);
  • Participate in meetings, conferences, and platforms of relevance to the work program described above, to advance and showcase IUCN technical and thought leadership to drive sector‑wide transformation, and to influence and mobilize new networks, partners, and stakeholders.
  • Nurture working relationships with existing partners and establish new partnerships in Brazil and in the region, including resource mobilization.

4. Collaborative Work with IUCN SUR, Brazil Team and IUCN Business & Nature team

  • Participate in events and meetings, with a special focus on (but not limited to) strengthening relationships with the private sector, while also engaging with other key stakeholders as needed.
  • Collaborate with the IUCN Regional team and the one in Brazil on a periodic basis on relevant projects, communicating with members and partners in Brazil and the region.
  • Attend technical meetings with the IUCN Business & Nature team and/or the Centre for Science and Knowledge and other global technical Teams to stay abreast of new tools development relevant to the position.
  • Provide technical input to other projects, products and deliverables, including reviewing and reference.
  • Contribute to the review of communications materials and translations.

The above job description contains the main duties and responsibilities for this position. However, in a small organization such as IUCN, staff members are expected to show flexibility in their approach to work and be willing to undertake other tasks that are reasonably allocated to them, but which are not part of their regular job description. Where any task becomes a regular part of an employee’s responsibilities, the job description will be changed in consultation with the employee and the Human Resources Management Group.

Requirements

  • Master’s degree in Biodiversity, Biology, Ecology, Natural Resources Management, Environmental Policy, Sustainability Management, or another relevant field required. Strong grounding in biodiversity, conservation, sustainable development and social science concepts and theory, beyond immediate field of expertise.
  • Minimum 8‑10 years of experience, and minimum 5 required in engaging and working with the private sector on biodiversity themes, for instance as a consultant, with a preference for experience on the ground in Brazil (environmental and/or biodiversity assessments, biodiversity net gain reviews or monitoring, certifications…).
  • Technical understanding of IUCN key standards, tools and metrics (in particular IUCN Red Lists of Threatened Species and of Ecosystems, Nature‑based Solutions global standard, STAR metrics, IBAT) or other scientifically reputable equivalents. Some experience with Life Cycle Assessments would be an asset.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in developing, managing and coordinating projects, including planning, execution, monitoring & evaluation, technical and financial management and reporting.
  • Experience in supervising staff and coordinating consultants.
  • Proven ability to operationalise concepts, from idea to ground implementation and to socialise and mainstream scientific concepts and approaches in order to encourage their appropriation by non‑specialist stakeholders.
  • Experience in planning and developing messaging in terms of effective knowledge uptake, understands and can adapt to target audience.
  • Ability to take initiative, exercise good judgment, think laterally and resolve complex issues in a dynamic and changing environment.
  • Demonstrates professionalism and diplomacy in cross‑cultural communication, respects diverse perspectives, handles sensitive information appropriately, and works effectively as a team player with audiences ranging from high‑level management to community‑based teams.
  • Works effectively under pressure, demonstrating strong organizational skills to prioritize and balance operational tasks, manage multiple deadlines, optimise the use of time, people, and resources, and anticipate and address critical dependencies.
  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills, with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Fluency in written and spoken Portuguese and English is required. Proficiency in written and spoken Spanish is desirable.
  • Relevant IT skills, in particular with online communication platforms for video conferencing and other collaboration;
  • Availability for some travel required in Brazil, in South America and perhaps internationally.
  • This position will be based in São Paulo, Brazil.

The minimum gross annual salary for this position is BRL 200,146. While this is an indicative amount effective as of the current date, changes may occur as per IUCN's compensation practices without prior notice. The same applies to other organisations hosted by IUCN.

description:
This opportunity is only for candidates currently residing in the specified country. Your location may affect eligibility and rates. Please submit your resume in English and indicate your level of English proficiency. At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real‑world expertise from across the globe.

About The Role

Mindrift is looking for passionate freelance contributors to join the Tendem project to help build the future of hybrid agents — where human expertise and AI capabilities work hand in hand. As an AI Agent Assistant, you’ll collaborate with large language models (LLMs) that handle repetitive tasks, while you bring the nuance, judgment, and creativity required to deliver high‑quality results. In this role, you won’t just review what AI produces — you’ll work alongside it, shaping and completing outputs so they are accurate, reliable, and ready for real‑world application.

Your day‑to‑day may range from fact‑checking a scientific claim to curating a dataset, conducting market research, or refining sales leads. This flexible, part‑time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with backgrounds in research, editing, analysis, or related fields who are excited by the possibilities of human‑AI collaboration. Your contributions will directly influence how AI systems learn, evolve, and support industries worldwide.

Typical tasks

  • Deliver well‑reasoned, accurate, and clearly written outputs backed by credible sources.
  • Conduct thorough web research to verify information and collect supporting evidence.
  • Collaborate with large language models (LLMs) and internal tools, using them as copilots to complete complex tasks.
  • Design and refine prompts to guide AI toward higher‑quality results.
  • Apply best practices for working with LLMs, understanding both their strengths and limitations.
  • Adapt quickly between diverse annotation, research, and analysis tasks while following detailed guidelines.

How To Get Started

Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you’ll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.

Requirements

  • You are currently enrolled in or have completed a Bachelor’s and/or Master’s degree in any field.
  • You have professional and/or educational experience in data annotation, demonstrate a deeper‑than‑user‑level interest in AI, and possess intellectual breadth and curiosity.
  • You are skilled in web searching, fact‑checking, intent‑checking, able to work with LLMs and have great attention to detail.
  • Your level of English is upper‑intermediate (B2) or above.
  • You are ready to learn new methods, able to switch between tasks and topics quickly and sometimes work with challenging, complex guidelines.
  • Our freelance role is fully remote so you just need a laptop, internet connection, time available and enthusiasm to take on a challenge.

Benefits

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $9/hour depending on your skills, experience, location and project needs.
  • Take part in a part‑time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio.
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

Excelentes habilidades técnicas, raciocínio analítico com habilidades interpessoais;

Experiência anterior com gestão de pessoas (direta ou indiretamente);

Disponibilidade para eventuais viagens internacionais.

description:

Aqui no Sesc em Minas, acreditamos que a valorização das pessoas é a base para a verdadeira transformação social. Para assegurar nosso propósito, estamos em busca de profissionais que desejam contribuir para o bem-estar e a melhoria da qualidade de vida dos comerciários e da comunidade.

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para atuar como MÉDICO(A) OTORRINOLARINGOLOGISTA na nossa unidade em Belo Horizonte/MG.

  • Atendimento aos pacientes conforme disponibilidade de agenda, por meio da realização de anamnese, exames físicos e complementares para diagnosticar condições relacionadas a ouvido, nariz, garganta, laringe e estruturas relacionadas, e traçar plano terapêutico individualizado, com a identificação dos riscos e benefícios do tratamento proposto;
  • Diagnosticar e tratar doenças do ouvido, nariz, garganta, laringe e pescoço. Incluem desde infecções agudas até condições mais complexas como tumores, além de distúrbios da voz, audição e sono;
  • Orientar os pacientes sobre os fatores de risco para doenças do ouvido, nariz, garganta, laringe e pescoço, nas consultas de rotinas, fornecendo orientações sobre hábitos de vida saudáveis para prevenção de doenças;
  • Monitorar a evolução das condições do ouvido, nariz, garganta, laringe e pescoço, ajustar tratamentos, por meio do acompanhamento dos pacientes em consultas periódicas, conforme necessário para garantir a saúde do indivíduo a longo prazo;
  • Acompanhar os contratos como Fiscal ou Gestor, se indicado pela liderança, assegurando o cumprimento eficaz dos termos e condições contratuais, garantindo que ambas as partes, contratante e contratada, estejam aderentes às obrigações acordadas, além de garantir a conformidade com as regulamentações e políticas internas, inclusive no que se refere à transparência e prestação de contas, entre outras atividades.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina
  • Residência Médica em Otorrinolaringologia ou Especialização Completa em Otorrinolaringologia, com Registro de Qualificação de Especialista (RQE) em Otorrinolaringologia.
  • Ter disponibilidade para trabalhar numa carga horária de 20 horas semanais.

Realizar atendimentos pediátricos e procedimentos ambulatoriais.

  • Seguro de vida;
  • Plano de Saúde (extenso a dependentes);
  • Vale-refeição ou vale alimentação (sem suspenção no período de férias ou licença maternidade).
  • Suprev – Plano de Previdência Privada (opcional).
  • Day off: uma folga no mês do seu aniversário para você curtir o seu dia como quiser.
  • Universidade Sesc: plataforma corporativa de aprendizado contínuo com treinamentos especiais para todos os empregados.
  • Cartão Cliente Sesc: tenha acesso ao mundo de possibilidades Sesc: consultas odontológicas e médicas, cursos, oficinas, áreas de lazer, pacotes de turismo, hospedagem e muito mais. Tudo com um preço especial.
  • Bolsa estímulo educacional: reembolso de até 50% em cursos de formação, especialização e idiomas. Invista em você! (Conforme as regras de política interna).

A O SESC valoriza a diversidade em todas as formas. Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas também às pessoas com deficiência ou reabilitados pelo INSS. title: Lifesharing Coordinator, ID/A Program
description:
Access Services is looking to welcome a Coordinator to our Lifesharing program team. The home base for this role is at our main office in Bethlehem, PA and requires regular travel in Lehigh, Northampton, and CMP counties.

You will be part of a team working to support adults with intellectual disabilities/Autism who live in our Lifesharing provider host homes. Our team works with the provider families and the individuals to ensure the home meets the needs and preferences of the person served. As a Coordinator, you will meet to review and update the individual's support plans, support the families and supervise the staff, which helps the individuals we serve attain their goals and live their best lives.

A Successful Lifesharing Coordinator Will

  • Be organized, detail-oriented, and have a willingness to learn the tech skills needed to use the systems we work in.
  • Be independent and confident in their ability to manage their cases, while being a team player and collaborating with the other coordinators in the department.
  • Be a responsible, out-of-the-box thinker who cares for the well-being of the people we serve and is willing to learn and advocate for them.
  • Maintain the individual's placement in their provider home.
  • Manage all relationships related to the case and exhibit emotional intelligence while working with the provider's different communication and emotional styles.
  • Care about people while also strongly prioritizing accuracy and details.
  • Have crisis management skills and patience.

A week in the life of a Lifesharing Coordinator might look like:

  • Being willing to step into the needs of the current day, as every day can look unique.
  • Weekly meetings with the Lifesharing department.
  • Meetings with the individual's team, their provider family, and county support coordinators.
  • Monitoring in the Lifesharing provider's home.
  • Managing the individual's medical care.
  • Prioritizing the volume of paperwork that is required with regulations and deadlines in mind.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist individuals in choosing a Lifesharing provider home that meets their individual needs and preferences.
  • Work as a team to help individuals develop their own individualized program plan.
  • Coordinate all supports outlined in the individual program plan.
  • Assist individuals in adjusting to their new homes, working through family conflicts, and becoming connected to their local communities.
  • Help ensure the safety of individuals through monitoring, maintenance, and implementation of all compliance and regulations.
  • Supervision of support staff.

Requirements

  • A Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university plus two years of work experience working directly with persons with intellectual disabilities / autism (ID/A).
  • OR An Associate's degree or 60 credit hours plus four years of work experience working directly with persons with ID/A.
  • OR A high school diploma plus six years of work experience working directly with persons with ID/A required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to effectively interact with all levels of staff, county and state officials, individuals, their families, and the general public.
  • Knowledge of principles and methods of habilitation.
  • Knowledge of behavior management, safety techniques and program planning principles.
  • Knowledge of basic concepts in family therapy and group work.
  • Knowledge of person-centered planning and the ability to help individuals meet their plan objectives.
  • Knowledge of disbursements of medications according to state licensing regulations. Knowledge of pertinent community resources and facilities.
  • First Aid and CPR certification required in this position. Access Services will provide the needed training and certification.

Essential Working Conditions/Physical Demands

  • Work in program sites, offsite locations, and the community routinely providing direct care and/or support with individual(s).
  • Stand, sit or run by self, or to provide proper care and supervision with an individual.
  • Able to move and stay with an individual to keep them safe, both in home environment and community, even when an individual may struggle to meet identified expectations.
  • Able to assist an individual who has fallen, regardless of weight or size.
  • Utilize desktop computer equipment daily and ability to lift or move items associated with sedentary work and light work (exert up to 20 lbs.).
  • Proficiency in, or ability to learn and use, workplace applications, platforms and technologies.

Benefits

  • Compensation: Starting at $20.75/hour, with adjustments made for education and experience; plus a competitive benefits package.
  • Work Schedule: Monday through Friday 9:00AM-5:00PM, flexibility with schedule and on-call rotation required. The location rotates from the Bethlehem office to the locations of the homes we serve in the Lehigh Valley.

Our Full-time Comprehensive Benefits Package Includes

  • Health, vision, Rx, and dental insurance with options for HSA/FSA.
  • Mileage reimbursement and paid travel time between worksites.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
  • Referral bonuses.
  • 401k match.
  • Tuition reimbursement and college tuition discounts.
  • 20 days paid off plus additional time with continued service. Paid holiday time. Catastrophic sick leave.
  • Company paid Life Insurance as well as Long and Short-Term Disability.
  • Ongoing professional development training.
  • Discounts on various services. Perks with local credit unions.

Team Overview

We're looking for a highly skilled and analytical CRM Data Analyst to join our team. This person will be responsible for supporting the design and execution of lifecycle journeys and communication strategies that support the growth of our business, ensuring users receive relevant, personalized, and timely communications. - Advanced skills in a business intelligence and data visualization tool such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker Studio.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable business insights.

description:
Overview

We are hiring an experienced IT System Administrator to help us scale, secure, and optimize our cloud infrastructure. This role is ideal for someone with a strong background in AWS, Terraform, and cloud automation, who also brings hands-on experience with services like Amazon FSx, Amazon WorkSpaces, and Amazon Q Business. You\'ll be a key contributor to infrastructure design, automation, monitoring, and Zero Trust security enforcement using tools like Spacelift, Zabbix, Zscaler, and Checkpoint CloudGuard.

Responsibilities, qualifications, and other details are described below.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and enhance AWS infrastructure, including core services (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC) and enterprise solutions such as Amazon FSx (Windows file storage), Amazon WorkSpaces (virtual desktops), and Amazon Q Business (AI-powered knowledge search).
  • Define and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code with Terraform, orchestrating deployments and policy enforcement using Spacelift or equivalent.
  • Set up and manage monitoring solutions with Zabbix to ensure infrastructure performance and reliability.
  • Implement and support Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) using Zscaler (ZIA/ZPA) for secure remote access.
  • Enforce cloud security practices through Checkpoint CloudGuard, covering workload protection and compliance.
  • Experience with managing an IDP (Okta or equivalent) users, groups logic, and application integration.
  • Collaborate with development and IT teams to manage infrastructure code via GitHub, with a focus on stability, peer review, and traceability.
  • Automate routine processes and improve system efficiency through scripting (Bash, Python, or similar).
  • Document infrastructure standards, system configurations, and operational runbooks.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing AWS infrastructure in production environments.
  • Strong expertise in Terraform, with a track record of managing infrastructure via code.
  • Experience with Spacelift or equivalent tools for Terraform deployment pipelines.
  • Operational knowledge of Amazon FSx (especially Windows File Server), Amazon WorkSpaces.
  • Familiarity with Zabbix for infrastructure monitoring.
  • Working knowledge of Zscaler (ZTNA) or equivalent and Checkpoint CloudGuard or equivalent for security and access control.
  • Working knowledge of MDM solutions for Mac and Windows (Jamf, Endpoint Central or equivalent).
  • Skilled in using GitHub for code versioning, collaboration, and review workflows.
  • Competence in scripting and automation using Bash, Python, or similar languages.

What we offer

  • Direct cooperation with the already successful, long-term, and growing project
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Collaborative and supportive team culture
  • Truly competitive salary
  • Help and support from our caring HR team

title: Volunteer System Manager
description:
Volunteer System Manager

Department: Events & Entertainment
Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, working together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”). The Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model. This role leads the set‑up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform while overseeing essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high-quality operational process for the tournament.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament‑time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
  • Act as the volunteer department’s main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT, and system simulations.
  • Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in‑line with FIFA’s data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision‑making.
  • Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
  • Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
  • Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct “Train‑the‑Trainer” sessions for system users.
  • Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost‑effective delivery methods.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
  • Ensure a structured systems close‑out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
  • Represent the Volunteer team in cross‑functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.

Your Profile

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in large‑scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
  • Education: Master’s in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
  • Proven experience managing large‑scale technology or systems implementation projects.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
  • High cultural awareness with experience in multi‑stakeholder and multicultural environments.
  • Training delivery experience a plus.
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
  • Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset.
  • Team player with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast‑paced environment.
  • Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community‑building, sport, and service.
  • Creativity and resourcefulness to enhance the volunteer experience and drive engagement.
  • Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.
  • Project management or Systems Management certification desired.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Senior Frontend Engineer (LATAM)
description:
Join to apply for the Senior Front End Developer (LATAM) role at Lateral Group

Lateral stands for technology excellence. We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses. A globally distributed team of 200+ experts united by a shared purpose: the continuous pursuit of quality. Our clients come to us for results, quality and craft - and stay because we keep raising the bar.

We do things differently at Lateral Our mission is simple: design and build great products . What sets us apart isn’t just the talent of our team - it’s the way we work . We have a bias for action and results. We are doers - we spot the gaps, connect the dots, anticipate what’s around the corner and take action. We move fast, stay focused, and let the results speak for themselves. We Work On Time, On Budget, On Quality – Discipline is our edge - a commitment we make to each other, to our clients, and to the standards we hold ourselves to. We Care Deeply . We care about our work and about each other. Care is a competitive advantage. Every detail matters – every design, every line of code, every decision. Thoughtful by default. We Do Things Right - Because It’s the Right Thing to Do . Right over easy. Integrity isn’t up for negotiation. We hold the bar high even when no one’s watching. We take pride in doing great work the right way - not the easy way. We Keep Improving . The best teams keep improving and we’re never done learning. We iterate. We reflect on what’s working and what’s not. Feedback fuels us, we receive it openly, and adapt quickly. Progress over perfection. We’re Obsessed With Agility, Not The Agile Manifesto . We don’t chase dogma or rituals - we chase momentum. We adapt processes to fit problems, not the other way around. We Take Ownership . Everyone leads something here. You will have room to run with ideas, and the trust to execute. That trust is built on how you show up: thinking things through, sweating the details, and following through.

What You’ll Do

As a Senior Front End Developer at Lateral, you will:

  • Craft delightful digital experiences: Design, implement, and maintain front-end features using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript. You’ll create reusable UI components and craft polished, responsive interfaces with a focus on quality.
  • Collaborate & communicate: Work closely with designers, back-end developers, and product managers in an asynchronous workflow. You’ll regularly communicate with clients to clarify requirements, demo features, and ensure we’re building the right thing.
  • Lead and take ownership: As a senior member, you’ll drive projects from concept to completion. That means making technical decisions, outlining implementation plans, and seeing them through deployment. You’ll have the freedom to introduce new ideas and best practices that raise the bar for our front-end, whether it’s improving our build process or adopting an innovative UI approach – all justified by real benefit to the team and product.
  • Optimize, Iterate & improve: Involve yourself in brainstorming and technical discussions. Ensure our apps are fast, accessible, and reliable. You’ll profile and improve page load times, refine animations, and tackle browser-specific quirks so that every user gets a smooth experience. When issues arise, you’ll dive in to debug and fix them, striving for robust solutions that scale and writing tests to prevent regressions.
  • Mentor and learn: Guide and mentor junior developers by sharing your expertise and providing constructive feedback. Stay curious and keep up with industry trends, frameworks, and standards. You’ll be encouraged to continuously learn and bring in knowledge, evaluating new technologies thoughtfully to see if they can enhance our product or developer experience. You’ll help shape a culture of excellence, ownership, and growth on the team.

Example Projects You May Join:

  • Large scale B2B2C Commerce Platform: Help build a responsive, mobile-first experience for an international e-commerce client. You might lead a dynamic multi-faceted search or a smooth checkout flow.
  • Develop from scratch an application: Collaborate with a senior backend engineer/architect to build a modern application. You’ll be involved in everything from crafting components to API definition.
  • Real-Time Medical Dashboard: Develop front-end features for a real-time analytics dashboard for a pet healthcare client. You might use libraries like AGCharts to visualize large data sets, implement live updates via websockets, and ensure the interface remains highly performant and user-friendly.

Whatever the challenge, you’ll be building software that changes lives and moves industries forward.

How We Measure Success In This Role

In the first two weeks: You\'ve set up your development environment and tools. You\'ve pushed your first meaningful contribution (bugfix, UI tweak, or minor feature). You’re familiar with our async workflows and communication style. You’ve participated in your first client sync and started understanding the project\'s context.

In the first 3 months: You\’ve led development on a significant feature or initiative. You’ve actively mentored a teammate or shared knowledge through code review or documentation. You\’ve authored or contributed to architectural decisions and design documents. You\’ve established trust with clients through clear communication and technical guidance. You\’ve improved performance, code structure, or tooling in meaningful ways.

After 3 months: You’re recognized as a technical leader in your project or team. You’ve initiated a broader improvement across projects (e.g., shared component library, new testing standard). You’re frequently unblocking teammates, elevating code quality, and proactively identifying risks. You balance speed and quality, delivering with care and clarity.

We measure success through: The impact and scope of your technical contributions. Your ability to lead initiatives, mentor others, and improve team practices. Code quality, performance, and maintainability. Positive feedback from peers, clients, and design/engineering leadership. Your growth mindset, communication skills, and influence on team culture.

What We’re Looking For We are seeking for team members who are both highly technical and deeply care about their craft and how the work gets done. You must bring:

  • 7+ years of professional front-end development experience building digital applications. Experience with modern Javascript libraries and tooling (e.g. React, npm, webpack...). Fluency in CSS and first-principles understanding front end technologies.
  • Proven ability to craft, polish, delight, sweat the details. You have an eye for design and UX. Pixel-perfect isn’t just a phrase to you – you care about creating beautiful, intuitive interfaces that make users happy. An understanding of design principles and attention to details like accessibility and responsive layout is important.
  • Quality and reliability: You take pride in building high-quality software. You’re diligent about testing and documentation, and you proactively debug issues before they become problems. Performance and browser compatibility matter to you – you know how to make a web app fast and handle the quirks of different environments. Ultimately, you balance speed of delivery with maintainability, ensuring the code you ship today won’t be tech debt tomorrow.
  • Self-driven and accountable: You’re comfortable managing your own projects and time without heavy oversight. When you take on a task, we can count on you to see it through with a sense of ownership. You’re a proactive problem solver who can break down complex problems, propose solutions, and drive them to completion. We trust our team members to be “managers of one” who take initiative and deliver results.
  • Great communication and empathy are a must. You enjoy working closely with others, be it in pair programming, brainstorming with designers, or reviewing a teammate’s code. You can explain technical concepts clearly, listen to alternate viewpoints, and work together to find the best solutions. Our culture is about being kind, open, and constructive, so we’re looking for someone who lifts others up and thrives in a friendly, collaborative environment.
  • Remote work skills: Self-motivated and disciplined in a remote environment. You can manage your time, collaborate asynchronously, and aren’t afraid to ask questions or offer help across time zones.

Bonus points for:

  • Demonstrating craft
  • Design /delight sensibility
  • AI & Gen AI experience/tooling
  • Understanding Backend concepts
  • CSR/SSR
  • DevOps experience (continuous integration, hosting, etc.)

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Real Impact: You’ll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference - from healthcare and commerce to sustainability and next-gen tech.
  • Remote-First, Office Friendly: Work from wherever you’re most productive - whether that’s your home, a co-working space, or one of our offices. We’re a remote-first company, but if you’re near an office, you’re welcome to drop in, collaborate in person, or work onsite regularly.
  • We prioritize async collaboration, respect your time zone, and focus on outcomes over hours.
  • An Outstanding Team: Talented, kind, and hard-working people who care deeply about their craft - and about each other. No egos. No politics. Just professionals doing their best work.
  • Growth: You’ll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility - at your own pace.
  • A Culture of Excellence: We care deeply about doing the right thing - for our clients, our team, and ourselves. No burnout. No crunch. Just high-quality work, delivered sustainably.
  • Variety & Stability: We’re profitable, independent, and over a decade strong. Yet every project brings a fresh challenge. You’ll never be bored here.

This Role Might Not Be for You

We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn’t. You should skip this opportunity if:

  • You prefer well defined structure. If you gravitate towards a clear hierarchy, well defined roles and swim lanes, you may find our self-managed style challenging.
  • Distributed work isn’t your thing. If you find async communication, design documentation and being proactive without a manager nearby difficult, our setup won’t suit you.
  • Feedback doesn\'t excite you. We’re obsessed with quality and believe in continuous improvement. That means we give feedback that’s sometimes nitpicky. If refining the work until it’s excellent feels over the top, you are likely going to find working here frustrating.
  • Change makes you uncomfortable. We’re scaling and maturing. That means not everything is perfect yet. Priorities shift. Processes evolve. If ambiguity is uncomfortable, this may feel bumpy.

However, If this sounds like fuel, we’d love to talk!

How to apply and what to expect in the interview process

Our hiring process is structured as a sequence of steps. Moving forward is based on how well the previous step goes. This helps us stay focused, fair, and respectful of everyone’s time. We will always:

  • Let you know clearly what the next step is
  • Share updates and feedback wherever possible
  • Invite questions if anything feels unclear

Not everyone progresses through every stage. That doesn’t mean you’re not great at what you do. Sometimes it’s about timing, team fit, or simply what we’re looking for at the moment.

Step 1: Express Your Interest with a Portfolio

If this sounds like your kind of team and you’re excited to bring your craft to Lateral, we’d love to hear from you. Please send us:

  • A brief note telling us what excites you about this role
  • Your Portfolio / Links to your work — Essential. This could be URLs, GitHub repos, code snippets, portfolio sites — anything that gives us insight into your craft
  • Your resume

A few tips:

  • Highlight any areas that made your work special
  • Avoid sharing anything sensitive or proprietary
  • If you’re sharing team projects, be sure to highlight your specific contributions

We’re not looking for perfection — we’re looking for insight into your thinking, creativity, and craft. Just show us your thinking, your process, and what you’re proud of. We review every application with care. If there’s a fit, we’ll reach out to schedule next steps.

Step 2: Talent Partner Conversation

Purpose: A structured discussion with our People Experience team to delve into your career trajectory, motivations, and alignment with Lateral\'s values.

What to Expect:

  • In-depth questions about your past experiences and decision-making processes.
  • Exploration of your career goals and how they align with the role.
  • Discussion about our company culture, availability, compensation and other logistics
  • Motivators and demotivators.
  • Your life outside coding.

Preparation Tips:

  • Reflect on your career journey and pivotal moments.
  • Be ready to discuss challenges you\'ve overcome and lessons learned.
  • Familiarize yourself with the Job Description, Lateral\'s mission and values.

Step 3: Take Home Assignment

Purpose: Provide a practical demonstration of your skills through a task resembling real work at Lateral.

Format: A paid for take-home assignment or a live session, depending on the role.

What to Expect:

  • Tasks designed to reflect actual challenges faced in the position.
  • An opportunity to showcase your problem-solving and technical skills.

Preparation Tips:

  • Set aside uninterrupted time to focus.
  • Explain your decisions and assumptions.

Step 4: Technical interview

Purpose: Assess your technical proficiency and problem-solving abilities.

Format: A collaborative session with our engineering team, focusing on real-world scenarios relevant to the role.

What to Expect:

  • Problem-solving exercises/questions that mirror tasks you\'d encounter in the position.
  • Discussions around your approach, reasoning, and solutions.

Preparation Tips:

  • Practice articulating your thought process clearly and concisely.
  • Be prepared to discuss in depth past projects and the technologies used.

Step 5: Operational interview

Purpose: Understand your approach to prioritizing, collaborating, shipping, and iterating.

What to expect:

  • How you prioritize and break down work.
  • How you collaborate across disciplines.
  • How you handle blockers, feedback, and iteration.

Preparation Tips:

  • Pick 1-2 meaningful projects you led or heavily contributed to.
  • Walk through your process: what worked, what didn’t, what you’d do differently.
  • Think about how you manage time, scope, and changing requirements.

Step 6: Reference Checks

Purpose: We believe references are about understanding, not just validation. We do not look for perfection, but to understand patterns, strengths, and context. We use them to learn how to support you best.

What to Expect: We’ll ask you for 2–3 people who’ve worked closely with you. These are often: former managers, senior peers or collaborators, mentors or people you\'ve mentored.

What we ask: We focus on how you’ve grown, where you shine, how you like to be led, and what support sets you up for success. We want practical advice for making this a great fit for you.

Yes, we do backchannels too: We do this when we feel we need more context. We will check with you if there are folks we should avoid reaching out to due to confidentiality or other reasons. And here’s our commitment: if anything surprising or unclear comes up in a backchannel, we’ll bring it directly to you. We believe in “no stories without you in the room.” You’ll always get the chance to share your side, context, or clarification.

Step 7: Offer

What Happens: If selected, you\'ll receive a comprehensive offer detailing compensation, and other pertinent information. Our hiring process is designed to be thorough yet respectful, ensuring a mutual fit. We encourage candidates to engage actively, ask questions, and view this as a two-way exploration.

  • Avaliar o estado nutricional do paciente, utilizando medidas antropométricas e exames laboratoriais, solicitados pelo Nutricionista ou por outro profissional (médico), a partir dos diversos métodos e técnicas cientificamente comprovados, considerando aspectos individuais e clínicos;

Prescrevendo dieta e/ou dietética, baseada nos diagnósticos nutricionais, considerando diagnósticos e condutas dos demais profissionais da equipe multiprofissional;

  • Avaliar sistematicamente a aceitação e adequação nutricional da dieta, a evolução do estado nutricional e clínica do paciente, fazendo alterações nas prescrições da dieta e/ou dietética e demais condutas, se necessário;
  • Planejar, desenvolver e avaliar o programa de educação nutricional destinado a cada paciente, sob seu cuidado;
  • Exercer alta em nutrição, registrar e assinar no prontuário todo atendimento de nutrição prestado ao paciente;
  • Participar do desenvolvimento de protocolos de pesquisas, realizar a avaliação de custos do setor, assim como, participar das discussões técnicas de negociação e/ou renegociação de contratos voltados a nutrição e dietoterapias;
  • Recorrer a outros profissionais de saúde, interagindo com a equipe multiprofissional, discutindo casos e ou solicitando pareceres técnicos especializados, quando necessário, visando a atenção integral ao paciente;

  • Colaborar com a formação e aprimoramento de outros profissionais de saúde, orientando estágios e participando de programas de treinamento nos serviços de saúde;

Sobre a empresa

Fundada em 1952, a Savoy com mais de 70 anos de existência no mercado imobiliário. Um caminho iniciado com projetos de loteamentos no litoral paulista e na região metropolitana de São Paulo e a partir da década de 80, direcionados à locação de imóveis comerciais e industriais.

São mais de 7 décadas de dedicação que fazem da Savoy uma referência em locação de espaços empresariais, industriais e escritórios de todos os tamanhos, além de áreas para depósitos, centros empresariais e de distribuição logística, galerias, lojas em shopping centers, imóveis na via pública, terrenos para novos usos, etc. Ou seja, inúmeros formatos de espaços para as mais diversas atividades e negócios.

A nossa missão é oferecer instalações comerciais para que o cliente possa estabelecer o seu negócio e prosperar, estando sempre atento às necessidades e oferecendo soluções de qualidade.

Como princípios estão nossos compromissos de estarmos sempre atentos às necessidades dos nossos clientes e participarmos ativamente do cotidiano da empresa, adaptando-nos adequadamente às novas situações e impulsionando mudanças, comunicarmo-nos de forma correta e tendo como objetivo a melhoria do ambiente de trabalho, colaborarmos sempre com boa vontade para atingir os objetivos da equipe e tomar iniciativas constantes para o desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal de todos.

Nossa busca contínua pelos bons resultados passa pela eficiência na utilização dos recursos, tendo como meta atingir a melhor manutenção de nossas instalações para que elas possam ser locadas rapidamente.

A história da nossa empresa mostra que o seu crescimento é fruto da importância que damos ao seu patrimônio e uma parte muito importante do mesmo é constituído pelos nossos colaboradores.

Motivação e comprometimento são os valores que acreditamos que devem estar presentes nas ações de todos, independentemente da idade, formação e função.

Construída com muito trabalho e dedicação, esta é uma história muito rica que conta com a sua participação. Venha fazer parte do nosso time! Na Savoy, acreditamos que as pessoas são responsáveis pelos resultados junto com a equipe. Se você gosta do que faz, está sempre querendo aprender mais e quer fazer a diferença, venha trabalhar com a gente. Estamos procurando talentos que queiram se juntar à nossa equipe. Faça parte do nosso time, queremos conhecer o seu potencial.

Estamos à procura de um Coordenador de Treinamento altamente talentoso e automotivado para se juntar a nós em nossa jornada para avançar no mundo tecnológico por meio da inovação e criatividade.


Anexar currículo em Inglês


Requisitos:



  • Excelente comunicação escrita e falada

  • Inglês avançado (Obrigatório)


Seu Papel & Responsabilidades



  • Propriedade do calendário: responsável pelo calendário para todas as partes interessadas (participantes e corpo docente). Atualizar calendários regionais, incluindo calendários do corpo docente e dos participantes.

  • Criação de listas relevantes para a classe e acompanhando os gerentes onde houver incerteza de elegibilidade. Confirmar os detalhes finais da lista com a equipe do corpo docente e sinalizar qualquer coisa digna de nota (por exemplo, participantes de nível sênior).

  • Comunicações: Gerenciar a implantação de comunicações para participantes e gerentes. Criar e gerenciar grupos de bate-papo de corte, incluindo grupos de bate-papo internos com os membros da equipe de ativação e corpo docente atribuídos à corte. Responder às dúvidas dos participantes e gerentes (por e-mail, ping/teams e um sistema de tickets). Criar eventos no LMS para preencher os calendários dos participantes e rastrear os níveis de conclusão. Inscrever os participantes em LPs/eventos relevantes no LMS. Marcar a conclusão/participação do participante após o GSS (quando aplicável).

  • Medição de dados: Atualize o trix com detalhes do participante para dar suporte ao rastreamento de dados.

  • Facilitação: Prepare o deck de boas-vindas e co-facile as sessões de boas-vindas para os participantes.

  • Produção ao vivo para aulas virtuais: Forneça suporte de produção durante as sessões ao vivo, quando relevante.

  • Produção presencial: Como parte de suas responsabilidades, o Coordenador deve estar no local em um escritório específico do cliente para fornecer suporte de produção para módulos presenciais. As responsabilidades para esta parte do programa incluem:

    • Configuração da pré-coorte: Coordenar e concluir a configuração da sala de aula, por exemplo, arranjos de mesa, decoração da sala, requisitos do corpo docente, preparação de material, incluindo apostilas nas mesas, brindes, impressão, adereços educacionais, etc. Coordenar a configuração da tecnologia e garantir que todos os sistemas estejam totalmente funcionais em parceria com a equipe de suporte técnico antes do início da sala de aula. Estabelecer contato com POCs do escritório local, por exemplo, painelistas, bufê, etc.

    • Produção em sala de aula: Rastreamento e acompanhamento de frequência (caso alguém esteja ausente). Ajustes da sala de aula ao longo do dia, por exemplo, configuração de espaços para atividades de breakout. Coordenar POCs do escritório local, por exemplo, painelistas, bufê, etc. Assistência de facilitação, por exemplo, distribuir folhetos, microfone móvel para impulsionar o envolvimento dos participantes, reposição de materiais de sala de aula, etc. Feedback de ação do corpo docente e participantes em relação à configuração/logística da sala.

    • Produção pós-corte: Limpeza e reconfiguração da sala de aula. Armazenamento seguro e inventário de materiais de treinamento. Finalizar e fechar tíquetes abertos com POCs de escritório, incluindo tecnologia e REWS, que exigirão verificações em sala de aula, por exemplo, equipamento de tecnologia devolvido com sucesso (laptops emprestados).



Por que nos escolher?



  • Somos uma das maiores empresas de tecnologia que mais crescem no mundo, com escritórios em mais de 54 países e 219.000 colaboradores. Nossa empresa é extremamente diversificada com 165 nacionalidades representadas.

  • Oferecemos a oportunidade de trabalhar com colegas espalhados ao redor do mundo

  • Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho virtual em primeiro lugar, promovendo uma boa integração entre seu trabalho e vida pessoal, em uma flexibilidade real.

  • Estamos comprometidos com seu crescimento, oferecendo oportunidades de aprendizado e desenvolvimento de carreira em todos os níveis para ajudá-lo a encontrar seu brilho único.

  • Oferecemos benefícios abrangentes para todos os funcionários

  • Somos certificados como Great Place to Work e Top Employer em 17 países, e reconhecidos como Top Employer no Brasil especificamente, oferecendo um ambiente de trabalho positivo que valoriza o reconhecimento e o respeito dos funcionários.


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos


Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

Overview

A Symrise é um fornecedor global de fragrâncias e aromas, matérias-primas e ingredientes ativos para cosméticos e ingredientes funcionais. Juntamente com seus clientes, a Symrise desenvolve novas ideias e conceitos competitivos para produtos indispensáveis no dia a dia. O sucesso econômico e a responsabilidade corporativa estão intrinsecamente ligados.

Symrise - sempre inspirando mais…

Qualifications

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

Nossa Compromisso com a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão.

Na Symrise, acreditamos que a diversidade é uma força que impulsiona a inovação, a colaboração e o crescimento sustentável.

Estamos comprometidos em construir um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas - independentemente de sua origem, raça , identidade de gênero , orientação sexual , deficiência(s), idade , crença, trajetória ou qualquer outro marcador identitário - sintam-se respeitadas, valorizadas e com oportunidades iguais para se desenvolver.

Valorizamos a equidade em nossos processos e buscamos continuamente identificar e eliminar barreiras sistêmicas que possam impactar negativamente a experiência de qualquer colaborador ou candidato (a/e).

Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de pessoas negras, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+, mulheres, pessoas com deficiência, pessoas 50+ e de outros grupos historicamente sub-representados no mercado de trabalho.

Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para movimentação de bagagens da esteira para equipamentos de transporte, calçamento, carregamento e descarregamento de aeronaves com malas e cargas, sinalização em torno do voo a ser atendido, inspeção e varredura do piso para coleta de objetos caídos, percepção auditiva para identificação de sinais sonoros de equipamentos e máquinas na pista.

Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.

As atividades consistem na organização da bolsa de suprimentos, aguardo da liberação de limpeza pela tripulação, acoplamento da escada na aeronave, coleta dos sacos de lixos, reposição dos suprimentos, aspiração do carpete, verificação da presença de objetos e higienização das poltronas e de bolsões, preenchimento de documentação do voo e limpeza das salas administrativas. Dentre os equipamentos utilizados destacam-se telefone, aspirador, panos, sacos de lixo, lixeira e bolsa de suprimentos. O setor encontra-se no subsolo, com acesso do colaborador ao posto de trabalho por elevadores e escadas rolantes e deslocamento pelas áreas operacionais do aeroporto.

Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura em bipedestação para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, deambulação por toda extensão do aeroporto para o atendimento do voo, rotação e flexão do tronco e esforço físico para limpeza e deslocamento da escada da aeronave.

Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para inspeções e limpezas e percepção auditiva para atendimento telefônico e detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais em áreas operacionais.

Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.

  • Auxiliar Administrativo (Operações)

As atividades consistem na gestão do faturamento e conciliação documental diária dos voos realizados, encaminhamento para departamento financeiro, elaboração de relatórios, lançamento de dados no sistema, arquivo, leitura e envio de e-mail. O setor encontra-se no piso térreo, com deslocamento do colaborador pelas áreas administrativas e operacionais do aeroporto por meio de elevadores e escadas rolantes.

Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e inferiores, postura variável para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, eventualmente existe a necessidade de esforço físico e deambulação entre áreas administrativas e operacionais do aeroporto.
